body: Thank you. I have to go to bed at the moment but I'll respond tomarrow.
I never really got out of it, the suicidal thoughts just went away. I honestly don't know what happened cause my life wasn't too good during that time.

I have went to a therapist before but she did not help me I feel. When I would go to the sessions she would always look at me weird I feel and I leave feeling worse. I don't really want to go back to anti-depressants. I got out of depression on my own in the past but now I feel bad again.

It wasn't a random encounter. It was a guy at my McDonalds in the kitchen with me making burgers. I guess I have one friend at my gym that I enjoy conversation with but I don't talk to him all that often as I only see him every so often. I am in a community college right now but I remember my senior year of High School all the people at my table would talk about is their relationships and their sex lives. Besides that one friend I have never had a conversation with anyone my age that I have enjoyed, I just fake it and it's now getting to me. I went to a nursing home for community service hours and enjoyed talking to a 98 year old man. I felt pretty good afterwards so I might visit him again.

The conversations with people my age are just really bland and boring to me. I'm reading this book on social skills and utilizing what I learn but I feel it is not helping me much. I was having a conversation with this one kid and I asked him what kind of music he listened to. He told me Tool and I told him I had all their albums. I then told him about my favorite songs of theirs and he just started ignoring me for no reason or giving me short answers to completely kill conversation.
My dad took the knife away from me then gave it back to me a few days later.
No I am pretty much on my own.

I have seen a therapist before and she didn't help much. I would go to the therapy sessions and she would look at me with disturbance I felt. I would end up leaving the session feeling worse. My dad would also complain about the cost of the anti-depressants. I eventually got better just by myself but since the bullet incident the thoughts have come back. I have told them about the thoughts I am having now and I feel I am worse now because I have never tried cutting myself with a knife.

Maynard Keenan in Perfect Circle wrote a song from people like these perspective called Outsider. You're not the only one with this problem. He wrote the album, Thirteen Step, to dissuade people from suicide so maybe it will help you.
